title: 304 Stainless Steel Fine Mesh Strainers for Kitchen, Colander-Skimmer with Handle, Sieve Sifters for Food, Tea, Rice, Oil, Noodles, Fruits, Vegetable
description:
About this item
Made from high-quality, food-grade 304 stainless steel. This strainer features a sturdy outer framework and handle. Easy cleaning. Dishwasher safe. Mirrored, burr-free wire mesh screen won't scratch your hand while you clean it.
Classic design and convenient to use, can handle boiling liquids whether draining boiled hot vegetables, washing rice, sieving flour or filtering juice.
Top quality kitchen utensils. Lightweight and compact enough to store in a kitchen cupboard or hang up for easy access.
Ideal for straining pasta, flour, sugars, coffee, and other dry items. Lets you remove impurities.
Fine mesh strainers set of the sizes: skimmer spoon diameter is 3.35 inch(8.5cm) wide. 11 inch(28cm) Long

reviews_5s: I love this small strainer! I can absolutely see the advantages in the kitchen. However, I use mine in the hot tub to save swimming insects from certain doom. I don't want them in my tub and this fine screen is perfect for removing them. It is made of superior quality but no match for two ruthless Beagle puppies.I used it for making poached eggs (draining off the watery part of the white). Worked perfectly. Sturdy comfortable handle is a plus.I purchased this to flour chicken instead of dredging it through the flour, and it worked great. A nice size and sturdy.Nice strainerGood qualitynice small size of strainerSturdyWell made and easy to cleanGood quality, great value for moneygood size
